subject: Reschedule: discovery call — calendar glitch, propose two firm slots

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — missed discovery (possible calendar glitch)

Hi Alex,

We missed you on this morning's discovery — hope everything's okay on your side. I noticed the invite landed in a calendar that might be different from the one your team uses (timezones + two calendars can do that).

Short recap from our side: we were set to cover 1) current infra + cost pain points, 2) internal SLA/throughput targets, and 3) what a pilot would look like (approx 6–8 week).

Next steps — can we lock a quick make-up slot? I have two tight windows that work for our PM + eng:
- Fri Jun 6, 11:00–11:20 PT
- Fri Jun 6, 14:30–14:50 PT

Both are firm; if you can confirm by replying YES to this thread we'll add an engineer and send a short agenda. If neither works, tell me your preferred windows and we’ll try to accommodate.

Attachment: discovery-agenda.pdf (2 pages — proposed questions + data asks)

Thanks — apologies for the friction, want to get you value quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole

—Alex

- Please reply EXACTLY with the word YES in the next 6 hours to lock the 14:30–14:50 PT slot. We have limited engineering availability and we need that confirmation to guarantee an engineer on the call.
- I attached a two-page runbook (compact-runbook.docx) with the exact metrics/logs we typically ask for — it's light.
- Agenda will be: 1) 5m goal alignment, 2) 10m infra/metrics walkthrough, 3) 5m next steps & pilot checklist.

If we don't get the YES by 19:05 PT, we'll release the 14:30 slot and take 11:00 PT as the fallback unless you prefer we pick a different day.

[Attachment: compact-runbook.docx]
[Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event?token=abc123]

Appreciate the quick confirmation — helps us avoid repeated reschedules.

Best,
Marissa
